youtube_description:
First part of the loco week with KTM Colombia. Underground drift and testing the streets together with amazing motocross rider Tatan Mejia, met the colombian dukers and became the member of the Street Brothers. What a great start of the week in Colombia! 

Add subtitles in your language: http://www.youtube.com/timedtext_video?v=2vkz8aJipZM&ref=share 

_____
Follow me here for more cool RokON stories:

Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/Bagoros.Rok/ 
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/rokbagoros
Web: https://www.rokbagoros.com 
Shop: https://shop.rokbagoros.com

Follow Tatan: https://www.instagram.com/tatanmejia/
_____
My name is Rok Bagoros and I am a pro freestyle streetbike rider. I began riding bikes when I was 17 and turned pro after 4 years when I signed a contract with KTM Factory. Since then my life changed and I started to travel the world to perform my freestyle live shows and competitions. On my channel I try to show you how my life looks like on and of the bike. 

I performed in Asia, South America, Europe and Middle East on the mayor events like MotoGP, Red Bull Air Race, DTM, Salon de Automovil Chile, Internatonal moto expo, EICMA, etc. 
On the other side I have been a stunt double for different artist like Robbie Williams, etc.

My motosport idols are: Ken Block, Travis Pastrana, Chris Pfeiffer.
